params.name: Footing maths
params.expr:
cxBase = skew=='left' ? (columnWidth-baseWidth)/2 : (skew=='right' ? (baseWidth-columnWidth)/2 : 0)
colPosY = -columnHeight
v1 = columnHeight + rccThickness
rccPosY = -v1
v2 = v1 + pccThickness
pccPosY = -v2
v3 = v2 + solingThickness
solPosY = -v3
depth = columnHeight + rccThickness + pccThickness + solingThickness
baseArea = baseWidth * baseDepth
